verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law-firm service with a client portal. A compliance and case-management platform could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring workflows such as periodic compliance reports, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only guided checklists, task lists and case deadlines managed by the attorney team (casium-docs-8, casium-docs-10). Nothing shows users can schedule recurring jobs or workflows, and probes found no API or OpenAPI surface for automation (casium-probe-3).
